name: Spider-Man pointing at Spider-Man

name: Epic Handshake
pose: two people clasping hands high in the middle, elbows bent, like an arm-wrestling grip

name: Distracted Boyfriend
pose: one person walks past; another turns to look back at them; the third glares at the one looking back

name: Three Spider-Men pointing
pose: three people all pointing at each other

name: Abbey Road

name: the Ginyu Force pose
